goal: Make the merged R/J/O canonical-Reality preflight effective for both new and pre-existing industry branches by applying a current-main, dependency-light contradiction check at the issue-triggered integration entry, while teaching all fresh agents the fact-completeness versus comparability distinction.
baseline_impact: none; this is rollout wiring and fresh-agent guidance for the already-merged CAP-0003/CAP-0007 preflight, reusing CAP-0009 continuity and CAP-0010 routing without changing any Reality/Judgment/Outcome/Evidence/PIT semantic expectation
baseline_invariants: dimensions_complete=false remains a CAP-0003 declaration that the FactAssertion itself lacks required dimensions and therefore must fail closed before canonical Reality

cross-entity or cross-issuer non-comparability remains separate from fact completeness and continues to be expressed through truthful dimensions/statistical scope plus downstream comparability and Outcome relation semantics
Grounded Evidence identity, locator, provenance and temporal rules remain unchanged
Reality, contemporaneous Judgment, later Outcome and PIT/no-lookahead remain separate and fail closed
worker branch/fence/single-writer ownership and global_serial integration authority remain unchanged
no L3/L4 Baseline, schema, semantic-owner or source-authority change is introduced
schema_impact: none; dependency-light JSON contradiction inspection, central workflow wiring, prompt guidance and regression tests only
acceptance: The default-branch issue execution workflow checks the exact target orchestration before database execution using a guard loaded from current main, so long-lived branches do not need their workflow file rewritten merely to inherit the protection.

An orchestration with a Reality projection explicitly containing dimensions_complete=false fails with a direct explanation before the generic reconciler reaches its identical inevitable REVIEW result.
A complete narrow issuer/entity-specific Reality projection passes while cross-entity comparability and related_milestone Outcome semantics remain independently fail-closed.

The cross-ref guard inspects only the stable explicit-false contradiction; all other schema, Evidence and semantic validation remains owned by the exact target branch executor, avoiding accidental future-main tightening of old branches.
The shared takeover and new-role prompts teach the same distinction to active and future disposable agents without imposing a blanket Judgment completeness rule.
Focused tests cover the failing and passing orchestration cases and prove the current-main guard executes before database execution.
No reconciler behavior, Judgment completeness rule, Outcome relation behavior, Evidence standard, source authority or PIT rule changes.
